lines.en: label springtime17:
scene senseifishbed1
The scene opens with our former hero positioned in the center of his bed, wearing a festive cap while surrounded by fish.
lines.zh: 场景开启，我们的前主角躺在他床的正中央，戴着一顶节日帽，四周全是鱼。

lines.en: Drool leaks from his mouth — the remnants of an unending dream left there to air dry until his {b}CARETAKER{/b} returns home.
lines.zh: 口水从他嘴角淌出来——那是一场无尽梦境的残迹，就这么晾在那里风干，直到他的{b}照护者{/b}回家。

lines.en: His eyes should be somewhat glazed over or, at the very least, aimed in a direction where it’s not entirely apparent if he is gazing straight forward or into the camera.
lines.zh: 他的眼神应当有些呆滞，或者至少望向某个方向，让人分不清他究竟是在直视前方，还是在盯着镜头。

lines.en: It is at this moment that the audience should begin to question just how much of what they are seeing is real if they have not already begun to do this.
lines.zh: 就在此刻，观众该开始怀疑自己所看到的到底有多少是真的——如果他们还没开始怀疑的话。

lines.en: A nostalgic knocking sound from a better game plays through the speakers or headphones- but could fall upon deaf ears if the ears in question belong to someone who still doesn’t get it after all this time.
lines.zh: 一段来自某个更好的游戏的、令人怀念的敲门声从扬声器或耳机里响起——不过，如果听的人到这会儿还没看懂，那这声音也不过是对牛弹琴。

lines.en: The fish flop about, acting all fish-like, as the narration drones on in an effort to buy some more time until the falling actions of the update commence, ultimately leading to another melancholic montage.
lines.zh: 鱼扑腾着，一副十足的鱼样，而旁白还在喋喋不休地拖时间，直到本次更新的 falling actions 开始，最终又通向另一段忧郁的蒙太奇。

lines.en: The reader should focus on the phrase “falling actions” in the prior sentence, harkening back to an earlier event in which the words were used to describe our former hero.
lines.zh: 读者应当留意上一句里的「falling actions」这个词组，它呼应了此前某个事件——那几个字曾被用来形容我们的前主角。

lines.en: Despite his condition, readers should not feel bad for him as he is a terrible man who does terrible things.
lines.zh: 尽管他这副模样，读者也不该同情他，因为他是个做尽坏事的烂人。

lines.en: His misery is justified and conceptually sickening given just whose disappearance has evoked such a faulty state.
lines.zh: 考虑到究竟是谁的失踪才让他陷入这种故障状态，他的痛苦既理所当然，又在概念上令人作呕。

lines.en: He should look helpless and lost and readers should take note of that because it’s a new development.
lines.zh: 他看上去该是无助而迷惘的，读者应当留意这一点，因为这是个新变化。

lines.en: By now, the reader should realize that the knocking on the door was all in our former hero’s head.
lines.zh: 到现在，读者该意识到，那敲门声全都是我们前主角脑子里的。

lines.en: So much of what they’ve seen has been in his head.
lines.zh: 他们看到的很多东西，都发生在他的脑子里。

lines.en: But as they gaze down at him from above, they should once again recall the fish, acting all fish-like, and think to themselves, “This {i}can’t{/i} be in his head if his head is both empty and in-focus.”
lines.zh: 但当他们从上方俯视他时，该再次想起那些鱼——一副十足的鱼样——然后暗自想：「既然他的脑子既空空如也又清晰对焦，这{i}不可能{/i}是在他脑子里。」

lines.en: In thinking this, they will be correct. But they should accept the shared delusions as it makes for a more interesting narrative with more room for symbolism and evocative imagery.
lines.zh: 他们这么想是对的。但他们该接受这份共有的妄想，因为这样叙事更有趣，也留出更多空间给象征和动人的意象。

lines.en: They should now be questioning just what is so “evocative” about fish acting all fish-like — or how their inclusion in the recent segments of the story contributes in any form.
lines.zh: 现在他们该追问的是：鱼摆出一副鱼样，到底「动人」在哪儿——或者它们在故事最近这几段里的出现，究竟起了什么作用。

lines.en: The audience does not and will not receive an answer to these questions as the fourth chapter of our story is the saddest of them all.
lines.zh: 观众不会、也永远不会得到这些问题的答案，因为我们故事的第四章是全部章节里最悲伤的一章。

lines.en: The love story is over — and left on the bed is a husk of a man who must be brought back to life by force as he has lost all will to live on his own.
lines.zh: 爱情故事已经结束——留在床上的是一具男人的空壳，必须靠外力强行让他活过来，因为他已经失去了独自活下去的全部意志。

lines.en: Again, a sound plays through the speakers. But this time, it is a more concerning one.
lines.zh: 扬声器里又响起一个声音。但这一次，是更让人担心的那种。

lines.en: : Ah! That was way louder than I thought it would be!
lines.zh: : 啊!比我想的响多了!

lines.en: : We just broke a window. What did you expect?
lines.zh: : 我们刚砸碎了一扇窗户。你还指望什么?

lines.en: In fact, there have been noises present this entire time.
lines.zh: 事实上，从头到尾一直都有声音。

lines.en: But despite those noises from the outside leaking in, the man on the bed and the fish do not move.
lines.zh: 可尽管外面的声音不断渗进来，床上的男人和那些鱼都纹丝不动。

lines.en: For the man, it’s because there is no reason to. It’s because he’s already blocked everything else out and hasn’t even {i}noticed.{/i} Nor could he if he wanted to.
lines.zh: 对那个男人来说，是因为没有理由去动。因为他已经把其他一切都屏蔽了，甚至根本{i}没注意到{/i}。就算他想注意也做不到。

lines.en: For the fish, it is because they are fish.
lines.zh: 对那些鱼来说，是因为它们就是鱼。

lines.en: : Oh god...what if his neighbors heard us? What if they call the cops?!
lines.zh: : 天啊……万一他邻居听见了呢？万一他们报警了?!

lines.en: : Can this not wait until we’re inside? Here, I’ll give you a lift.
lines.zh: : 这事儿能不能等我们进去再说？来，我托你一把。

lines.en: NOT PICTURED — Io Ichimonji clasps her hands together, making a flesh-step for Uta Ushibori to use in order to get inside of her teacher’s room.
lines.zh: 未画出——Io Ichimonji 双手交握，搭成一个肉台阶，好让 Uta Ushibori 踩着爬进她老师的房间。

lines.en: She obliges and places her foot on the flesh-step, hoisting herself up toward the window as Io pushes.
lines.zh: 她照做了，把脚踩上肉台阶，在 Io 的托举下朝窗户攀去。

lines.en: Uta Ushibori manages to avoid cutting her hands on the glass but, unbeknownst to her, she was about to encounter a much more serious problem.
lines.zh: Uta Ushibori 成功避开了被玻璃割伤双手，但她不知道，一个严重得多的问题正等着她。

lines.en: : Okay! I think I’ve got it from- ah!
lines.zh: : 好了!我想我从这儿能——啊!

lines.en: scene black
She falls.
lines.zh: 她摔了下去。

lines.en: scene senseifishbed2
But it’s not her first experience with falling.
lines.zh: 但这不是她第一次体验坠落。

lines.en: : Ngh...ow...
She’d been gaining a great deal of experience in that field over the last year or so.
lines.zh: 在过去这一年左右，她在这个领域已经积累了相当丰富的经验。

lines.en: And while the last two months may have caused that to slow down a bit, they do little to slow the beating of her heart when she opened her eyes.
lines.zh: 虽然最近两个月让这个过程慢了下来，但当她睁开眼时，心跳却丝毫没有放慢。

lines.en: scene senseifishbed3
Thump thump. Thump thump. Thump thump.
lines.zh: 咚咚。咚咚。咚咚。

lines.en: Hers wasn’t the only heart still beating. But as her hand on the former hero’s sweaty chest becomes familiar with the rhythm of a black heart, she finds no comfort.
lines.zh: 还在跳的，不止她一颗心。可当她按在前主角汗湿胸口的手渐渐熟悉了那颗黑心的律动时，她没有感到半点安慰。

lines.en: Yet she {i}does{/i} find solace.
lines.zh: 但她{i}确实{/i}找到了慰藉。

lines.en: : Uh? Hello? A hand, please?
lines.zh: : 呃？喂？搭个手行吗?

lines.en: : Sensei?...
lines.zh: : Sensei?……

lines.en: : Hey — you didn’t die, did you? Did a shard of glass get lodged in your-
lines.zh: : 嘿——你没死吧？是不是有玻璃碎片扎进你——

lines.en: : Io! I think...I think something’s wrong!
lines.zh: : Io!我觉得……我觉得有点不对劲!

lines.en: : Well...how wrong? Sensei’s in there, isn’t he?
lines.zh: : 嗯……多不对劲？Sensei 在里面吧?

lines.en: : I’m not sure...
lines.zh: : 我不确定……

lines.en: scene black
NOT PICTURED — Uta Ushibori breaks away from the man and retreats to the window to help her friend climb inside.
lines.zh: 未画出——Uta Ushibori 从男人身边抽身，退回窗边，帮她的朋友爬进来。

lines.en: She neglects to stare at his exposed penis, signifying just how serious this situation is.
lines.zh: 她连他暴露在外的鸡巴都没顾上看，足见事态有多严重。

lines.en: scene senseifishbed4
: Dorm 7 rescue squad, reporting in for duty! Sorry for the racket. I had a bit of trouble getting the bars off.
lines.zh: : 七号宿舍救援队，报到!抱歉动静这么大。拆那些栏杆费了我点功夫。

lines.en: : Io, I don’t think he’s going to respond to you.
lines.zh: : Io，我觉得他不会回应你的。

lines.en: scene senseifishbed5
: Yeah, he doesn’t look too great. But hey, at least he’s got a cute hat on.
lines.zh: : 是啊，他看起来状态不怎么样。不过话说回来，至少他戴了顶可爱的帽子。

lines.en: scene senseifishbed6
: Io! Really?!
lines.zh: : Io!你认真的?!

lines.en: : Sensei, blink if you can hear me.
lines.zh: : Sensei，听得见就眨眨眼。

lines.en: scene senseifishbed7
: Yeah, you’re right. Something’s definitely wrong. But his eyes are open, so at least it’s not like he’s in a coma or anything. Probably just catatonic.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你说得对。肯定是出事了。不过他眼睛是睁着的，所以至少不像昏迷什么的。大概是紧张性木僵吧。

lines.en: : But why?...
lines.zh: : 可是为什么?……

lines.en: : Well, I imagine we wouldn’t be here if we knew the answer to that. But we are, which means we’ve gotta get a move on before Ami gets back or we’re {i}really{/i} in trouble.
lines.zh: : 嗯，要是我们知道答案，就不会在这儿了。可我们确实在这儿，也就是说，得赶在 Ami 回来之前动手，不然我们就{i}真的{/i}麻烦了。

lines.en: scene senseifishbed8
: Shouldn’t we call an ambulance or something instead?
lines.zh: : 我们不是该叫救护车什么的吗?

lines.en: : Uta, we just broke into a house. I don’t think we should be calling {i}anyone.{/i}
lines.zh: : Uta，我们刚闯进别人家。我觉得我们{i}谁{/i}都不该叫。

lines.en: : Besides, there’s a chance he’s just {i}on{/i} something. You’ve seen me get like that before after taking too much of my meds.
lines.zh: : 再说，他有可能只是{i}嗑{/i}了什么。你以前见过我吃药吃多了也这样。

lines.en: : And if he’s as messed up as Ami’s been making it sound, chances are she’s giving him something to keep him...grounded.
lines.zh: : 而且如果他真像 Ami 说的那么糟糕，那她多半在给他吃什么东西，好让他……安稳下来。

lines.en: : Grounded?...He doesn’t even know we’re here. This isn’t {i}grounded.{/i} He’s {i}gone.{/i}
lines.zh: : 安稳?……他根本不知道我们在这儿。这{i}不叫安稳{/i}。他是{i}没了{/i}。

lines.en: : Lucky for him, I have a million things back at our room that might be able to help with that. But, that’s the thing. {i}We need to get back to our room.{/i} Now, sit him up while I get rid of the broken glass.
lines.zh: : 算他走运，我们宿舍里有一大堆东西说不定能帮上忙。但问题就在这儿。{i}我们得回宿舍去。{/i}现在，你把他扶起来，我去收拾碎玻璃。

lines.en: : Getting him through the window will be the hardest part. Just make sure not to knock over the replacement on the way down or I’ll have nothing to...you know, replace the window {i}with.{/i}
lines.zh: : 最难的是把他弄出窗户。下楼时小心别把那块替换的玻璃碰倒，不然我就没东西……你知道的，没东西拿来{i}换{/i}窗户了。

lines.en: : So we’re...{i}really{/i} kidnapping him, huh?
lines.zh: : 所以我们……{i}真的{/i}是在绑架他，是吧?

lines.en: scene senseifishbed9
: Huh?! Sensei?! Are you awake?!
lines.zh: : 啊?! Sensei?! 你醒了?!

lines.en: scene springsanta42
: You...You {i}want{/i} to stay?...
: But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : Could be Stockholm Syndrome. Without knowing what the fuck Ami is doing, it’s hard to say. Like...maybe he really {i}is{/i} just super messed up right now.
lines.zh: : 可能是斯德哥尔摩综合征。不知道 Ami 到底在搞什么鬼，很难说。比方说……也许他现在真的{i}就是{/i}被搞得很惨。

lines.en: : S-Sensei! Do you...Can we talk? I really- {i}we{/i} really miss you and...we want to know you’re okay.
lines.zh: : Sensei!你能……我们能谈谈吗？我真的——{i}我们{/i}真的很想你，而且……我们想知道你还好好的。

lines.en: : Nothing good.........leaving the house.........
lines.zh: : 出去没好事………………离开这屋子………………

lines.en: : Learned.......my lesson...........
scene senseifishbed10
: Well, that certainly makes this harder.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这下事情肯定更难办了。
: Io……

lines.en: : I think we might’ve made a mistake...
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们可能搞错了……

lines.en: : Again, we don’t {i}know{/i} that. But we’re definitely not going to find out while we’re in {i}here.{/i} So I say we stick to the original plan of you sitting him up while I get rid of all the glass. Then, we lift.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，我们{i}并不知道{/i}。但我们肯定没法在{i}这儿{/i}搞清楚。所以我建议还是按原计划：你把他扶起来，我把玻璃全清了。然后，抬人。

lines.en: scene senseifishbed11
: Ami will obviously know Sensei’s missing when she gets back. But I can cover our tracks well enough so  she won’t know it was {i}us{/i} who got him out of here.
lines.zh: : Ami 回来后肯定会知道 Sensei 不见了。但我能把痕迹处理干净，让她不知道是{i}我们{/i}把他弄走的。

lines.en: : She’ll probably just think he left on his own and then, boom — Sensei is free again and everything goes back to normal.
lines.zh: : 她大概只会以为他自己走了，然后砰——Sensei 又自由了，一切恢复正常。

lines.en: : Yeah...Yeah.
: He doesn’t actually...{i}want{/i} to stay here. He just...
lines.zh: : 他其实并不{i}想{/i}待在这儿。他只是……

lines.en: : He {i}thinks{/i} he does...
lines.zh: : 他{i}以为{/i}自己想……

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: : But that’s not...
lines.zh: : 可那不是……

lines.en: : He’s not...
lines.zh: : 他不是……

lines.en: : He’s not supposed to be here...
lines.zh: : 他不该在这儿……

lines.en: : What do {i}you{/i} know about where my uncle is {i}supposed{/i} to be?
lines.zh: : 我叔叔{i}该{/i}在哪儿，你{i}又{/i}知道什么?

lines.en: scene senseifishbed12
: A-Ami! It’s not-
lines.zh: : A-Ami!不是——

lines.en: : What do {i}you{/i} know about the pain he’s felt?...Or the struggles he’s endured?...Or the dreams that keep him up at night?...
lines.zh: : 他受过的痛苦，你{i}又{/i}知道什么?……他熬过的挣扎呢?……那些让他夜不能寐的梦呢?……

lines.en: : We-
lines.zh: : 我们——

lines.en: : What do you know about {i}anything?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你到底知道{i}什么{/i}?

lines.en: : We just-
lines.zh: : 我们只是——

lines.en: scene senseifishbed13
: It’s a rhetorical question. You’re not {i}supposed{/i} to answer because the three of us already know the truth.
lines.zh: : 这是反问句。你不{i}该{/i}回答，因为我们三个都已经知道真相了。

lines.en: : You heard it yourself. He doesn’t {i}want{/i} to leave. He wants to stay with {i}me{/i} because {i}I’m{/i} the one he trusts. {i}I’m{/i} the one who wants to protect him. Not {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你亲耳听到了。他不{i}想{/i}走。他想跟{i}我{/i}在一起，因为{i}我{/i}才是他信任的人。{i}我{/i}才是想保护他的人。不是{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : Like, who even {i}are{/i} you?
lines.zh: : 说真的，你{i}到底{/i}是谁啊?

lines.en: : You isolate yourself from ever getting to know any of us then turn around and try to kidnap my {i}uncle{/i} instead? No wonder you’re on so many pills. You’re a fucking lunatic.
lines.zh: : 你把自己孤立起来，从不肯真正认识我们任何一个人，转过头却来绑架我的{i}叔叔{/i}？难怪你吃那么多药。你就是个他妈的疯子。

lines.en: : Ami! That-
lines.zh: : Ami!那——

lines.en: scene senseifishbed14
: And {i}you...{/i}
: I thought we were {i}friends.{/i} Now you’re breaking into my house?
lines.zh: : 我还以为我们是{i}朋友{/i}。现在你却闯进我家?

lines.en: : Were you just using me to get to Sensei as well? Is that all {i}everyone{/i} does nowadays? Because it sure seems like it.
lines.zh: : 你也是在利用我来接近 Sensei 吗？现在{i}所有人{/i}都这样了吗？因为看起来确实是这样。

lines.en: : It’s not like that! We were worried about him! We haven’t seen him since Halloween and we don’t even know what happened!
lines.zh: : 不是那样的!我们只是担心他!从万圣节之后我们就再没见过他，甚至不知道发生了什么!

lines.en: scene senseifishbed15
: And that makes it okay to break into my house?!
lines.zh: : 所以这就可以闯进我家了?!

lines.en: : I know you’re an idiot, Uta, but come on! Are you serious?! Is that really the best you can do?! You were {i}worried?!{/i}
lines.zh: : 我知道你笨，Uta，但拜托!你是认真的吗?! 你最好的借口就这个?! 你{i}担心?!{/i}

lines.en: : Yeah...we were. Is that so hard to understand?
lines.zh: : 对……我们是担心。这很难理解吗?

lines.en: scene senseifishbed16
: A little bit, yeah!
lines.zh: : 有那么一点，没错!

lines.en: : I mean, you didn’t see {i}me{/i} break into {i}your{/i} room when I found nudes of Uta in Sensei’s phone! And I think that’s a {i}way{/i} bigger thing to worry about than a teacher taking an extended vacation!
lines.zh: : 我是说，我在 Sensei 手机里发现 Uta 的裸照时，你也没看见{i}我{/i}闯进{i}你{/i}房间啊!而且我觉得，比起一个老师休个长假，那才是{i}更{/i}该担心的事吧!

lines.en: : Wha-
: Huh?! What?! But I never-
lines.zh: : 哈?! 什么?! 可我从来没——

lines.en: : Granted I’m not {i}sure{/i} they were Uta’s nudes since they didn’t come from her. And the girl in the picture probably hadn’t even hit puberty yet.
lines.zh: : 当然，我也不{i}确定{/i}那是 Uta 的裸照，毕竟不是她发的。而且照片里的女孩大概还没发育呢。

lines.en: : The resemblance was kinda uncanny, though. But, hey! I gave you the benefit of the doubt because, again-
lines.zh: : 不过长得是真像。但是，嘿!我还是选择相信你，因为，再说一次——

lines.en: scene senseifishbed17
: I thought we were friends.
lines.zh: : 我还以为我们是朋友。

lines.en: : But now I’m starting to regret ever letting you around him in the first place.
lines.zh: : 但现在我开始后悔，当初根本就不该让你靠近他。

lines.en: : Did...
lines.zh: : 难道……

lines.en: : Did Sensei really...
lines.zh: : Sensei 真的……

lines.en: scene senseifishbed18
: Again, {i}who{/i} are you? Because you’re sure not some girl who’s about to pretend she knows even a fraction of the person my uncle is.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，你{i}到底{/i}是谁？因为你显然不是那种会装作了解我叔叔哪怕一丁点的女孩。

lines.en: : I...obviously don’t think I know him better than you do. But-
lines.zh: : 我……我显然不觉得我比你更了解他。但是——

lines.en: : As much as I appreciate you deciding to finally try and have a conversation with me, I’m not really sure how fond I am of it happening with glass all over my uncle’s bed.
lines.zh: : 虽然我很感谢你终于决定试着跟我聊两句，但我不太确定我会喜欢在我叔叔床上全是玻璃的情况下聊。

lines.en: : Do you have any idea what I would do to you if he got hurt? Because {i}I{/i} don’t. And you know it’s bad when even {i}I{/i} don’t know something.
lines.zh: : 你知道如果他受伤了，我会对你做什么吗？因为{i}我{/i}都不知道。连{i}我{/i}都不知道的事，那肯定很可怕。

lines.en: : Io...Io was going to fix the window...we weren’t going to just leave things like that.
lines.zh: : Io……Io 本来打算把窗户修好的……我们不会就这么丢下不管的。

lines.en: scene senseifishbed16
: Oh! Well, why didn’t you just say so?! That makes everything a zillion times better!
lines.zh: : 哦!那你干嘛不早说?! 这一下让事情好了一万亿倍!

lines.en: : Hey, quick question while you’re smiling — are you drugging him? Because he seems {i}pretty{/i} out of it for just “being sick.”
lines.zh: : 嘿，趁你还在笑，问你个快问题——你在给他下药吗？因为他如果只是「生病」，那状态{i}未免{/i}太恍惚了。

lines.en: scene senseifishbed19
: Why do you ask? Want some?
lines.zh: : 你为什么这么问？想要点?

lines.en: : For the record, I’m not going to hold it against you if you are. I just want to know how serious this is and whether or not he needs {i}actual{/i} medical help.
lines.zh: : 先声明一下，如果你有，我也不会拿这个来针对你。我只是想知道情况有多严重，以及他需不需要{i}真正的{/i}医疗救助。

lines.en: : And I want to know why you think I give a shit about whether or not you’re going to “hold something against me.”
lines.zh: : 而我倒想知道，你凭什么觉得我会在乎你会不会「拿什么来针对我」。

lines.en: : No one knows what’s better for my uncle than I do because {i}I{/i} have done this before.
lines.zh: : 没有人比我更清楚什么对我叔叔好，因为{i}我{/i}以前就做过。

lines.en: : That man you met and grew oh-so attached to in school is only {i}that man{/i} in the first place because I was able to help him overcome his fears.
lines.zh: : 你在学校里认识、并且那么依恋的那个男人，之所以一开始会是{i}那个男人{/i}，是因为我帮他克服了恐惧。

lines.en: scene senseifishbed20
: Which is exactly what I’ve {i}been{/i} doing since Halloween! Until {i}you two{/i} decided to go and ruin it! Now, I have to start all over!
lines.zh: : 而这正是我从万圣节起{i}一直{/i}在做的事!直到{i}你们俩{/i}跑来把它毁了!现在，我得从头再来!

lines.en: : We’re sorry...we knew it was a stupid plan, but-
lines.zh: : 对不起……我们知道这计划很蠢，但是——

lines.en: scene senseifishbed21
: I don’t care.
lines.zh: : 我不在乎。

lines.en: : But...you know what?
lines.zh: : 不过……你知道吗?

lines.en: : Since it’s Christmas...and I am a {i}very{/i} generous girl...
lines.zh: : 既然今天是圣诞节……而我又是{i}非常{/i}大方的女孩……

lines.en: : Why don’t I give you guys ten seconds to get the fuck out of my house before things gets a lot messier? Then, we can forget this ever happened! Sound good? Good!
lines.zh: : 那我就给你们十秒钟，趁事情还没变得更难看，赶紧滚出我家，怎么样？然后我们就当这一切没发生过!听起来不错吧？不错!

lines.en: : Ami-
lines.zh: : Ami——

lines.en: : Ten.
: Nine.
scene senseifishbed22
: Let’s go, Uta. She can fix her own window.
lines.zh: : 走吧，Uta。她自己的窗户自己修。

lines.en: : Eight.
: Seven.
: Six.
: Five.
: Four.
: Please be good to him.
lines.zh: : 请好好对他。

lines.en: : Three.
scene senseifishbed23
: Two.
: One.
scene amibreak2
scene amispecial1x
scene andsoami
scene senseifishbed24
: What the fuck what the fuck what the fuck what the fuck what the fuck what the fuck what the fuck?!
lines.zh: : 他妈的他妈的他妈的他妈的他妈的他妈的他妈的?!

lines.en: : Right?!
lines.zh: : 就是啊?!

lines.en: : Like, I’ve heard that she can be kind of unhinged, but what the fuck was that?!
lines.zh: : 我听说她有点疯，可那到底是他妈的怎么回事?!

lines.en: : Right?!?!
: I mean...we {i}did{/i} break into her house and try to kidnap her uncle....but still!
lines.zh: : 我是说……我们{i}确实{/i}闯进她家、还试图绑架她叔叔……但这也太过分了吧!

lines.en: : Why didn’t Sensei want to leave?! Why was Ami so...creepy?!
lines.zh: : Sensei 为什么不想走?! Ami 为什么那么……诡异?!

lines.en: : And why does he have your fucking pictures?!
lines.zh: : 还有他为什么会有你那些该死的照片?!

lines.en: scene senseifishbed25
: I don’t know! But now I’ll never be able to look at him again without remembering that piece of information and I have no idea how that makes me feel!
lines.zh: : 我不知道!但现在我再看他，就一定会想起这件事，而我完全不知道这让我作何感想!

lines.en: : Uhh...I mean...shouldn’t it make you feel gross? And, like...kind of disgusted by him?
lines.zh: : 呃……我是说……这难道不该让你觉得恶心吗？还有，就是……有点嫌弃他?

lines.en: : Yes! But there are a lot more things swimming through my head and I can’t get ahold of any feeling long enough to decide what to do about {i}anything!{/i}
lines.zh: : 是啊!可我脑子里还有一大堆东西在打转，我抓不住任何一种感觉，久到足以决定该拿{i}任何事{/i}怎么办!

lines.en: scene senseifishbed26
: We’ve gotta get him out of there, Io...
lines.zh: : 我们得把他从那儿救出来，Io……

lines.en: : Ami might’ve made some good points just now, but...there’s something still really fishy about all of this.
lines.zh: : Ami 刚才说的不无道理，可是……整件事还是透着股说不出的古怪。

lines.en: : And I just...I don’t think he’s safe in there.
lines.zh: : 而且我只是……觉得他在里面不安全。

lines.en: : And I’m not convinced she isn’t drugging him...so I agree. But what the fuck are we supposed to do now that she knows we’re actively {i}trying?{/i} We could get in serious trouble if we come back here again.
lines.zh: : 而且我不信她没在给他下药……所以我同意。不过既然她已经知道我们在{i}动手{/i}了，我们还能怎么办？要是我们再回来，可能会惹上大麻烦。

lines.en: scene senseifishbed27
: I have no clue...
lines.zh: : 我一点头绪都没有……

lines.en: scene black
: I don’t even know where to {b}begin.{/b}
lines.zh: : 我甚至不知道该从哪儿{b}开始{/b}。
